content: {"episode_id":"ep-05080","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration of the denial for CPT 93271 is requested based on the documented recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries. The clinical indication note states that the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with underlying arrhythmias indicate cardiac event monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or ischemic changes. The supplied clinical indication note does not document that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient."}
